description: herdr per-pane subscription events are named pane.agent_status_changed but the global EventKind is pane_agent_status_changed; filtering on the raw name misses one form
resolution: Normalize '.' to '_' (model::parse_event does) and never filter on the raw event name

description: herdr's socket serves one request per connection then closes; reusing it gives BrokenPipe, and a second events.subscribe on the same connection is silently dropped.
resolution: Open a new connection per call; one dedicated connection per subscription (see herdr/local.rs).

content: CLI `herdr agent read` (including --machine) prints raw text, not JSON; only the socket's agent.read returns {result:{read:{text}}}. Server errors are JSON on stderr exit 1; usage errors are text exit 2.
